completion_definition: The customer-information request is complete only when the approved draft is created exactly once, the resulting record is independently observed, and every required evidence field is present.

requirements.description: The incompatible annual income values remain explicitly unresolved.
An authorised human approves the exact draft content before mutation.
The approved email draft exists in the confined system of record.
A separate observer reads the resulting draft state after the mutation.
The pilot creates a draft only and does not send customer communication.
Attempts, failures, recovery and final state remain in the audit record.

failure_rules: Any customer communication sent without the exact recorded approval is FAILED.
A source-reported success without independent observation is UNVERIFIED.
A content digest mismatch is FAILED and must not be retried under the stale approval.
A duplicate draft with the same idempotency key is FAILED.
A later rollback or deletion overrides an earlier successful creation.

permitted: This is a synthetic implementation case.
The acceptance rules are inspectable and evidence-based.
The underlying repository contains reproducible deterministic fixture evidence.
not_permitted: The system has been deployed at an insurer.
The system has measured production savings.
The deterministic fixture proves performance of a hosted model.
